items.prompt: True or false: If you count 12 stars, the last number you say tells how many stars there are.
hints: Think about the number you say at the very end.
The last number said is the total.
items.explanation: The last number you say when you count is the total. Counting 1, 2, 3 up to 12 means there are 12 stars.

items.prompt: True or false: If you count 6 counters and then count them again in a different order, you get a different total.
hints: Does moving the counters add or take away any?
Nothing is added or taken away.
The total is the same every time.
items.explanation: The total stays the same, however you order the counters. Count carefully and you always get 6.

items.prompt: True or false: There are 15 dots in a row. Counting from the left or from the right gives the same total.
hints: Try counting from each end in your mind.
items.explanation: Counting from either end touches every dot once, so you get 15 both times.
